descriptions: Fixed sending money by picking a contact always failing with 'Action failed'. It now pays the contact's main account, and shows a clear message if that number has no bank account.
Fixed the Copy IBAN buttons doing nothing inside phones. Copying now works on every phone and on desktop.
The Phone App setup guide now covers GKSPhone V2 — Docs → Banking → Phone App.
Note: paying a contact goes to their main account, so they need to be online (same rule as IBAN transfers to a main account).
